data_objects.name: partitioned_scene_features
data_objects.meaning: Monthly application records with record and scene identifiers, train/test assignment, binary label, and indexed AFT v4 and PAC v2 feature families.

variables.name: scene_code
variables.meaning: Categorical scene code represented as scene followed by an integer.

variables.name: flag
variables.meaning: Provided data-partition indicator with observed values train and test.

variables.name: label
variables.meaning: Binary 0/1 outcome indicator; the positive event is not defined.

variables.name: aft_v4_f0 … aft_v4_f44
variables.meaning: Forty-five indexed AFT v4 numeric features; the family contains mixed numeric scales and explicit special-looking values such as -1.

variables.name: pac_v2_x0 … pac_v2_x27
variables.meaning: Twenty-eight indexed PAC v2 numeric features on a score-like scale.

structure.description: The table is record-grained. rowkey identifies rows, flag supplies the partition, scene_code supplies a categorical segment, and apply_date is monthly rather than daily.

uncertainties: The label definition and the meanings/calibration of indexed AFT and PAC features are not documented.
annotation_notes: Do not parse apply_date as YYYYMMDD; it contains only year and month.
Indexed AFT and PAC columns are grouped as regular high-dimensional families.
